title: Oncogenic modulation of MAPK signaling in leukemia via SPNS2-driven sphingolipid metabolism and membrane nanodomains remodeling
task: Elucidate sphingolipid metabolism-driven membrane nanodomain remodeling and MAPK signaling in AML
key_results: SPNS2 modulation alters sphingomyelin levels, disrupts membrane nanodomains, and sensitizes AML cells to MEK1/2 inhibition; low SPNS2 expression correlates with increased MAPK inhibitor sensitivity in patient cohorts
comments: Integration of multi-omics with high-resolution imaging provides mechanistic insight, though causality between nanodomain disruption and signaling suppression could be more directly interrogated.

model_io.model: Mouse AML model with SPNS2 gain/loss-of-function

hypotheses.hypothesis: SPNS2-mediated sphingomyelin depletion disrupts membrane nanodomains and suppresses oncogenic MAPK signaling
hypotheses.result: SPNS2 reintroduction decreases sphingomyelin, disrupts nanodomains, and limits leukemic progression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low SPNS2 expression sensitizes AML cells to MAPK pathway inhibition
hypotheses.result: SPNS2 silencing functionally sensitizes AML to MEK1/2 inhibition in vivo; low SPNS2 patients show heightened MAPK inhibitor sensitivity

title: Macrophage biology and immunoregulation in health and disease
task: Review molecular mechanisms integrating ontogeny, metabolism, and epigenetics in macrophage plasticity and function
key_results: Macrophage behavior emerges from coordinated integration of ontogenetic imprinting, environmental sensing, metabolic rewiring, and epigenetic remodeling; this framework informs next-generation therapeutic strategies
comments: Comprehensive review synthesizing recent multi-omics advances in macrophage biology, though specific quantitative data on individual mechanisms are absent given the review format.

title: Tubulin acetylation regulates nuclear shape fluctuations and DNA repair
task: Elucidate mechanism by which nuclear mechanics promotes DNA double-strand break repair
key_results: Tubulin acetylation drives nuclear shape fluctuations that enhance homologous recombination efficiency; inhibiting acetylation reduces DSB mobility and causes DSB clustering at nuclear periphery with cell-cycle arrest
comments: Novel mechanistic link between cytoskeletal dynamics and genome stability, though the in vivo relevance of transient nuclear fluctuations remains to be validated in organismal contexts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nuclear fluctuations driven by microtubule forces accelerate homology search during HR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; inhibiting tubulin acetylation abolishes fluctuations and impairs HR while preserving non-homologous end joining

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vimentin cage removal is sufficient to restore nuclear dynamics and repair
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; vimentin deletion rescues nuclear fluctuations and repair efficiency without tubulin acetylation

title: Motile vesicles (MoVes) are a cancer cell migration-associated extracellular vesicle population
task: Characterize a novel extracellular vesicle population associated with cancer cell migration
key_results: Motile vesicles (MoVes; 2–5 μm) are shed from trailing edges during epithelial–mesenchymal transition and contain genomic DNA spanning the parent cell genome, organelles including mitochondria that enhance oxidative phosphorylation in recipients
comments: Comprehensive characterization of MoVes reveals them as a distinct EV class with potential functional impacts on recipient cells, though the relative contribution of mitochondrial cargo versus genomic DNA transfer to tumor progression remains unresolved.

model_io.model: Cancer cell migration-associated extracellular vesicle generation

hypotheses.hypothesis: MoVes arise specifically from trailing-edge retraction during mesenchymal migration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via live-cell imaging and scanning electron microscopy showing active shedding by migrating cancer cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: MoVes-associated mitochondria enhance oxidative phosphorylation in recipient cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mitochondrial cargo from MoVes functionally enhances OXPHOS

title: ADP-ribose induces neuronal ferroptosis through ENT2-mediated nucleotide rewiring
task: Identify metabolic pathway by which ADP-ribose accumulation triggers neuronal ferroptosis
key_results: ADP-ribose inhibits ENT2 nucleoside transporter, suppressing salvage and hyperactivating de novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis; this drives superoxide bursts via XO/DHODH and ferroptotic death; dual XO/DHODH inhibition rescues cognitive deficits in intracerebral hemorrhage models
comments: Elegant mechanistic dissection of NAD+ catabolite toxicity with clear therapeutic targets, though the relative contribution of each biosynthetic enzyme to ferroptosis induction remains partially unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ADP-ribose directly binds and inhibits ENT2 to suppress nucleotide salvage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; extracellular ADP-ribose inhibits ENT2-mediated nucleotide transport

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metabolic rewiring through XO/DHODH hyperactivation triggers ferroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; dual XO/DHODH inhibition rescues neurodegeneration in vivo

title: Exploiting iron metabolism in Ewing sarcoma
task: Review therapeutic strategies targeting iron metabolism in Ewing sarcoma
key_results: Multiple pre-clinical studies show Ewing sarcoma sensitivity to perturbed iron homeostasis with encouraging therapeutic results; review identifies specific mechanisms and translational potential
comments: This is a review article summarizing existing evidence rather than presenting original experimental data, limiting extractable quantitative findings.

title: Statistical inference of keystone taxa reshaping the assembly rules of forest root microbiomes
task: Identify keystone taxa reshaping root microbiome assembly rules in forest ecosystems
key_results: Assembly landscape framework identifies endophytic fungi (Phialocephala, Oidiodendron) as keystone taxa reorganizing community states; prokaryotic transitions between Pseudomonadota and Actinomycetota states driven by Candidatus Udaeobacter and endophytic fungi; findings validated on independent European datasets
comments: Statistical framework for keystone identification is scalable and ecologically motivated; linking microbiome assembly to ecosystem processes is novel, though causality remains correlative.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Endophytic fungi drive reorganization of root microbiome assembly landscape
hypotheses.result: Phialocephala and Oidiodendron strongly associated with landscape topography shifts; patterns confirmed in independent European datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Keystone prokaryotes (Candidatus Udaeobacter) mediate transitions in dominant bacterial phyla
hypotheses.result: Prokaryotic communities transition between states characterized by core taxa, Pseudomonadota, or Actinomycetota abundance

title: Population-scale single-nucleus multi-omic profiling of skeletal muscle reveals extensive context-specific genetic regulation
task: Map genetic regulation architecture of skeletal muscle via population-scale single-nucleus multi-omics
key_results: 13 cell types identified across 287 biopsies; >7,000 eQTLs and >100,000 caQTLs discovered; ~3,500 GWAS signals colocalize with sn-eQTL/caQTL predominantly in cell-specific manner; caQTL colocalizations more prevalent than eQTL for trait mapping
comments: Large-scale integration of snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, and genetic variation is methodologically rigorous; G×C interactions highlight cell-type-context specificity often missed in bulk studies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell-type-specific regulatory variants underlie polygenic metabolic disease susceptibility
hypotheses.result: 3,500 GWAS signals colocalize predominantly in cell-specific eQTL/caQTL; caQTL colocalizations more informative than eQTL

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin accessibility intermediates genetic effects on gene expression
hypotheses.result: Causal directional maps constructed linking chromatin and expression QTLs; 2,000 eGenes colocalize with caQTL

title: Integrating bioinformatics analysis with molecular simulation to elucidate the therapeutic mechanism of Guizhi Fuling Wan for adenomyosis and endometriosis
task: Elucidate therapeutic mechanism of Guizhi Fuling Wan for adenomyosis and endometriosis
key_results: 76 active ingredients and 480 GFW targets identified; 176 intersection targets with adenomyosis/endometriosis; core ingredients (cerevisterol, kaempferol, baicalein) stably bind AKT1; PI3K-Akt, MAPK, and apoptosis pathways implicated
comments: Multi-omics integration is comprehensive, but experimental validation in cellular or animal models would strengthen mechanistic claims beyond in silico predictions.

inputs: hub protein targets (AKT1, MAPK3, HSP90AA1, BCL2, TP53, ESR1, JUN)

hypotheses.hypothesis: GFW acts via multi-target synergy on neuro-endocrine-immune-metabolic axis
hypotheses.result: Seven hub targets and four major pathways identified; molecular dynamics confirm stable binding of core ingredients to AKT1

title: Hybrid feature pyramid attention and capsule network (FpaNet+CapsNet) for enhanced spatial and contextual feature extraction for improved brain tumor segmentation
task: Segment glioma tumors in brain MRI using hybrid attention and capsule networks
key_results: FpaNet+CapsNet achieved Dice scores of 99.05% (enhancing tumor), 98.05% (tumor core), 99.50% (whole tumor) on BraTS2020 test set; 99.6% overall accuracy; 0.962 Dice on BraTS2021 unseen data
comments: Ablation studies validate both architectural components; excellent performance metrics, but clinical translation requires prospective multi-center validation and comparison against radiologist inter-observer variability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feature Pyramid Attention captures multi-scale context while Capsule Network preserves spatial structure
hypotheses.result: Ablation tests confirm both modules contribute; combined model outperforms single-module variants

title: Delay-induced dynamics and Hopf bifurcation in a quarantined SEIQR epidemic model with nonlinear incidence
task: Analyze delay-induced bifurcation dynamics in quarantined SEIQR epidemic model
key_results: Hopf bifurcation conditions established with time delay τ as bifurcation parameter; R₀ < 1 ensures local asymptotic stability of healthy equilibrium; periodic oscillatory solutions characterized analytically
comments: Rigorously extends classical epidemic models with saturated nonlinear incidence and explicit bifurcation analysis, though practical parameter validation against real epidemiological data is absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Time delay in quarantine induces Hopf bifurcation and oscillatory dynamics
hypotheses.result: Sufficient conditions for bifurcation derived; direction and stability of emerging periodic solutions determined

hypotheses.hypothesis: R₀ < 1 stabilizes disease-free equilibrium; R₀ > 1 stabilizes endemic equilibrium
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via Routh–Hurwitz criterion

title: Supervising the search process produces reliable and generalizable information-seeking agents
task: Process supervision for information-seeking agents
key_results: Re2Search++ achieves substantial improvements on multi-hop benchmarks with strong out-of-domain transfer; search critics transfer across models including proprietary LLMs
comments: Shifting supervision from outcomes to process steps is an elegant insight, though the claim of 'reliability' depends heavily on the quality of process labels which may be expensive to obtain at scale.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Process supervision improves generalization compared to outcome-only supervision
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: stronger out-of-domain performance and reduced reward hacking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reasoning reflection is critical for search agent quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: identified as key capability through systematic investigation

title: ESAD-Net: an efficient steel adaptive detection network for real-time surface defect detection
task: Real-time steel surface defect detection
key_results: ESAD-Net achieves 87.0% mAP@0.5 and 115.3 FPS; 6.8pp improvement over YOLOv8n baseline, 13.2pp gain on small defects
comments: Solid engineering combining lightweight backbone design with adaptive sample selection, though the 25% parameter reduction claim and edge deployment viability need independent validation.

outputs: defect bounding boxes with confidence scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATSS adaptive sample selection mitigates class imbalance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: positive sample utilization increased from 15.2% to 24.8%; false positive rate reduced to 6.7%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale fusion with edge enhancement improves small defect detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 13.2pp average improvement on small target defects

title: Bidirectional cross-scale detail-semantic collaborative network (BCDS-Net) for vision-based waste recognition
task: Vision-based waste image classification
key_results: BCDS-Net achieves 96.73% accuracy on TrashNet, 92.15% on RealWaste, 96.23% on TrashBox with 41 samples/s inference on edge hardware
comments: Strong empirical results, but the restriction to single-label classification per image significantly limits real-world applicability where multi-waste scenarios are common.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bidirectional cross-scale aggregation improves multi-scale feature fusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: outperforms baselines on scale-stratified evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model generalizes under occlusion and image degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: stable recognition demonstrated across condition-stratified benchmarks

title: Integrated on-chip quantum light sources on a van der Waals platform
task: Demonstrate integrated quantum light sources on van der Waals platform with waveguide coupling
key_results: Single-photon g²(0)=0.003₋₀.₀₀₃⁺⁰·⁰³⁰ (single-port) and 0.076±0.023 (cross-correlated); waveguide-coupled out-coupled rate ~357 kHz (estimated minimum 1.68 MHz), from strain-engineered bilayer WSe₂ emitters coupled to WS₂ waveguides
comments: High-purity single-photon generation with efficient waveguide coupling is promising, though the discrepancy between single-port and multi-port g² measurements warrants clarification.

model_io.model: Integrated van der Waals quantum photonics platform

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strain-engineered WSe₂ emitters efficiently couple to multimode WS₂ waveguides with high purity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieved near-unity purity and MHz-scale coupled rates

title: Exciton-driven Floquet engineering from first principles
task: Engineer Floquet band structure via exciton-driven internal drive from first principles
key_results: Captured subgap excitonic resonance in monolayer h-BN; demonstrated clear Floquet sidebands and band renormalization from oscillatory excitonic field without temporal pump-probe overlap
comments: The first-principles approach combining rt-TDDFT with Floquet analysis is novel, but computational cost and applicability to larger systems or other materials remain unclear.

model_io.model: Real-time TDDFT with modified long-range-corrected kernel + Floquet-band analysis + time/angle-resolved photoemission simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Excitons act as internal drive enabling Floquet engineering without direct laser dressing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: oscillatory excitonic field generates Floquet effects even without temporal pump-probe overlap

title: Cometary impacts an unlikely pathway towards the origins of life on Earth
task: Reassess cometary contribution to prebiotic molecular delivery for life's origins
key_results: Rapid decline in Earth's cometary impact bombardment combined with efficient destruction of fragile organics during hypervelocity impact indicate cometary delivery of prebiotic feedstock was extremely rare
comments: The paper challenges a decades-old paradigm with updated impact simulations and dynamical models, but alternative delivery pathways (meteorites, hydrothermal synthesis) and uncertainty in pre-impact comet composition merit continued investigation.

model_io.model: Integrated impact simulations, comet-atmosphere interactions, and cometary orbital dynamics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cometary impacts efficiently delivered prebiotic molecules in concentrations sufficient for abiogenesis
hypotheses.result: Rejected: successful delivery was exceedingly rare due to molecular destruction and declining impact flux

title: Machine learning for advancing gamma source localization in a human phantom using NaI (Tl) detector spectra in radiobioassay
task: Localize gamma radiation sources in human phantom using ML classification of detector spectra
key_results: Logistic regression achieved 100% localization accuracy for GI organ; decision tree reached 97.4%; performance degraded for Ba-133 (spectral overlap) and whole-body detector (geometric symmetry)
comments: The modular approach is practical for constrained settings, but the small dataset and poor performance on low-energy isotopes and symmetric geometries suggest limited real-world applicability without data augmentation.

model_io.model: Four ML classifiers (LR, DT, SVM, MLP) trained per isotope-detector configuration
inputs: 10 statistical features (mean, skewness, kurtosis, entropy, IQR, etc.)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Statistical spectral features enable accurate isotope-organ localization
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: LR/DT effective for GI/thyroid, but failed for Ba-133 and symmetric WB geometry

title: Hierarchical structure of primary and hybridization-induced superconducting correlations in bilayer nickelates
task: Elucidate microscopic pairing mechanism in bilayer nickelate superconductors
key_results: Hierarchical pairing structure revealed: primary pairing from Ni 3d_{z²} bonding-antibonding splitting redistributes correlations to d_{x²-y²} channel via orbital hybridization; s± gap symmetry robust against Fermi-surface changes
comments: The distinction between pairing origin and resulting correlations elegantly resolves competing theories, though experimental verification of orbital contributions remains needed.

model_io.model: Variational Monte Carlo on bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Orbital hybridization redistributes superconducting correlations despite weak intrinsic d_{x²-y²} pairing tendency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: both channels exhibit comparable long-range correlations

title: A nanoscale map of the human cell surface proteome reveals spatial and functional organization
task: Map spatial organization and functional modules of human cell surface proteome
key_results: Identified 85 surface antigens organized into functional modules including TCR complexes and novel membrane-associated mitochondrial proteins; ML classifier predicted IL-10 receptor β regulation of type I interferon signaling
comments: Proximity labeling provides valuable spatial context but may miss transient or weak interactions; the functional significance of detected mitochondrial surface localization requires independent validation.

model_io.model: Proximity labeling + data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry

outputs: IL-10R β - type I interferon signaling regulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell surface proteome exhibits functional modular organization beyond known complexes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; discovered modules including previously unknown membrane-associated clusters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mitochondrial proteins localize to plasma membrane with functional roles
hypotheses.result: Detected; suggests underappreciated membrane functions requiring validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: IL-10 receptor β regulates type I interferon signaling
hypotheses.result: Predicted by ML classifier; indicates cross-pathway regulatory connection
